# Portland

> A self-hosted, on-device Pinterest alternative for Android. Save images and videos into boards on your phone, or sync them to a Cloudflare R2 bucket you control. No accounts and no tracking.

Portland is open-source (MIT) software. The Android app stores the library on the device by default. Optional sync uses a Cloudflare R2 bucket the person brings. Optional image descriptions run on Cloudflare Workers AI in that same account. This website is a static landing page. It does not collect accounts, run analytics, or set tracking cookies.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.portland.n1m35h.in/): Product overview, features and download
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.portland.n1m35h.in/privacy): What stays on the device, what an optional R2 bucket does, and what this website does not collect
- [TNC](https://www.portland.n1m35h.in/tnc): MIT license, your own bucket, and no warranty
